{{Top|leg}}
A '''pound''' was a unit of weight. The weight of a [[Human/Legends|Human]] was sometimes calculated in pounds. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]] weighed 180 pounds during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="RPG">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'']]</ref>
